approved_aura_offers_status: Tapiwa's table 'AURA offer cards', filled in 9 Nov 2026 (Google Sheet, sheet Offers). Rules: Launchpad, Equity Studio, Sprints and Managed Execution are proposed/planned, never available; no guaranteed funding, introductions or results; no unlimited usage; every offer except Free needs a human check before it is mentioned.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA AI Free
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA AI Free ($0, ongoing Free plan): free entry point for founders to begin planning and using AURA. Features: AURA chat and guidance; core workspace; Company DNA; pitch and document workflows; Investor Matching; included monthly AI usage. Limits: monthly AI usage limits; Data Rooms, investor pipeline, analytics, Meeting Copilot and custom agents are Pro-only; no guaranteed funding.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA AI Pro
approved_aura_offers.human_check_reason: Human review required (Tapiwa's table): verify exact features, price and billing cadence; reject guaranteed results and unlimited-use claims; human review before external messaging.
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA AI Pro ($99 per user/month, or $828 per user/year, $69/month equivalent billed annually): paid founder workspace for building a company and managing investor-readiness workflows. Features: everything in Free, plus investor pipeline and introduction workflow, Data Rooms, analytics, Meeting Copilot, custom agents and higher included AI usage. Limits: usage remains limited; does not automatically include managed services or guarantee investor introductions, meetings or funding.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA Startup Launchpad
approved_aura_offers.human_check_reason: Human review required (Tapiwa's table): Launchpad is proposed and not open for purchase; human commercial approval required.
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA Startup Launchpad (proposed, not currently for sale): proposed hands-on startup foundation service. Planned features: business/market review, financial projections, branded pitch deck, lightweight marketing website, go-to-market plan and handover. Price: proposed $5,000 before applicable tax, third-party costs and scope changes. Limits: not open for purchase; excludes bespoke apps, incorporation, paid ads, regulated advice and guaranteed fundraising; this is NOT an investment in IdealApp. Never claim open checkout, fixed delivery dates or guaranteed results.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA Equity Studio
approved_aura_offers.human_check_reason: Human review required (Tapiwa's table): Equity Studio is proposed, applications are not open; human and legal approval required.
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA Equity Studio (proposed): proposed selective services-for-future-equity pathway for eligible startups. Concept: company and founder assessment, identity/ownership checks, independent review and potential counsel-approved service agreement. No approved public price, equity percentage or standard terms. Limits: applications are NOT open; no automatic acceptance, equity issuance, investment, returns or exits. Do not imply applications are open or promise equity terms.

approved_aura_offers.name: Investor-Ready Sprints
approved_aura_offers.human_check_reason: Human review required (Tapiwa's table): Investor-Ready Sprints are an internal concept, not orderable; any external mention needs human review.
approved_aura_offers.text: Investor-Ready Sprints (planned, not currently orderable): planned short specialist-supported investor-readiness service. Indicative only: readiness-gap review, investor-materials support and prioritised action plan; exact scope not finalised. No approved public price. Availability, deliverables, turnaround times and commercial terms are unapproved; no guaranteed introductions or funding.

approved_aura_offers.name: Managed Execution Services
approved_aura_offers.human_check_reason: Human review required (Tapiwa's table): Managed Execution Services are an internal concept; any external mention needs human review.
approved_aura_offers.text: Managed Execution Services / Desk (planned): planned ongoing hands-on support beyond AURA software subscriptions. Indicative only: agreed founder tasks, delivery coordination, follow-through and evidence checks; exact services still under review. No approved public retainer or contract rate. Not automatically included with Free or Pro; availability, service levels and terms are not approved.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA AI Enterprise
approved_aura_offers.human_check_reason: Human review required (Tapiwa's table): Enterprise may be described as contact-led; specific quotes and contractual commitments need human approval.
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA AI Enterprise (contact-led): plan for larger teams requiring tailored workspaces and commercial arrangements. Features: everything in Pro; tailored workspace configuration, expanded collaboration and enterprise implementation/support. Custom pricing, contact IdealApp. Limits: no standard public quote, guaranteed service level or specific integration commitment; details depend on contract.
